title.zh-TW: 依分享文案，透過連結可享 7 天免費試用
title.en: Per the share text: a 7-day free trial through the link

text.zh-TW: 分享文案寫「7 天免費試用」；連結頁面只有「Claim free guest pass」按鈕，沒有寫天數與內容。取自分享文案與連結頁；以官方公告為準。
text.en: Share text: 7-day free trial. The link page has only a “Claim free guest pass” button. From the share text and link page; official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（沒有邀請碼，id 已在網址中）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link (there is no code; the id is already in the address).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示操作，按鈕為「Claim free guest pass」；若需要安裝 App，請只從官方商店頁面安裝。
steps.en: Follow the page, whose button reads “Claim free guest pass”; if an app install is needed, install only from the official store listing.

steps.zh-TW: 若頁面或 App 要求註冊或登入，請依指示操作。
steps.en: If the page or app asks you to register or log in, follow its directions.

steps.zh-TW: 開始前，請在 App 或商店確認試用與續訂條件。
steps.en: Before starting, check the trial and renewal terms in the app or store.

intro.zh-TW: 透過邀請連結加入 LeapAhead，依分享文案可享 7 天免費試用；沒有邀請碼，請直接用本頁連結開啟。
intro.en: Join LeapAhead, a book-summary app, via this link; the share text offers a 7-day free trial. No invite code.

description.zh-TW:
LeapAhead 是讀書學習 App，把書的重點整理成約 15 分鐘的音訊與文字摘要。App 可免費下載，另有 App 內訂閱項目。

本頁連結是分享文案中的連結，網址帶有 id 參數，沒有邀請碼，請直接透過本頁連結開啟。連結頁面的按鈕是「Claim free guest pass」；分享文案寫 7 天免費試用，頁面沒有說明天數與資格。實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
LeapAhead is a book-summary learning app that condenses books into audio and text briefings of about 15 minutes. The app is free to download and has in-app subscription items.

The link on this page is the one from the share text. Its address carries an id parameter and there is no invite code, so open the link on this page directly. The link page has a button labeled “Claim free guest pass”. The share text mentions a 7-day free trial, but the page does not state the length or who qualifies. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 連結原樣保留，沒有邀請碼。2026-10-24 維運者以瀏覽器開啟：頁面標題 Gift Card Redemption，按鈕 Claim free guest pass；7 天只見於分享文案。註冊時邀請是否被接受，沒有測試。leapaheadapp.com 頁尾與 App Store 賣家同為 Cyberspace Imagination Pte. Ltd.，gift. 是 leapaheadapp.com 的子網域；條款頁本站沒有讀到。
notes.en: The link is kept exactly as shared and has no invite code. On 2026-10-24 the maintainer opened it in a browser: the page is titled Gift Card Redemption with a Claim free guest pass button; the 7 days appear only in the share text. Whether the invitation is accepted at sign-up was not tested. The footer of leapaheadapp.com and the App Store seller both name Cyberspace Imagination Pte. Ltd., and gift. is a subdomain of leapaheadapp.com; the terms page was not read.

q.zh-TW: LeapAhead 的連結需要輸入邀請碼嗎？
q.en: Do I need an invite code for the LeapAhead link?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案與連結頁面都沒有顯示邀請碼；網址中的 id 是連結的一部分，請直接透過本頁連結開啟。App 內是否另有邀請碼欄位，本站沒有查證。
a.en: Neither the share text nor the link page shows a code; the id in the address is part of the link, so open the link on this page. Whether the app has a code field was not checked.

q.en: What does the 7-day free trial include?

a.zh-TW: 7 天來自分享文案。連結頁面沒有說明試用內容、資格或是否限用一次，所以本站不列更多細節，請以官方公告與 App 內說明為準。
a.en: The 7 days come from the share text. The link page does not say what is included, who qualifies or whether it is single-use, so no more is listed; follow the official announcements and the app.
